notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Another great news is that Russian and German are now avaiable for the game!

notes.title: v1.1.0 Release Notes
notes.notes:
v1.1.0 Release Notes
- Fixed a bug where the whole game freezes after some events.
- Fixed a bug where all pauses in the game took longer than expected on some computers.
- Supported Steam Cloud.
- Added an exit button on the title screen.
- Some other subtle bug fixes.

notes.title: Trick & Treat Remake is now released!
notes.notes:
After over a year's development, we are glad ro annouce that Trick & Treat Remake and Art Book Vol.2 are released, with 40% off release discount!
I hope this remake version can bring you some Halloween mood, and maybe a little nostalgia feelings.

Please check the [url=https://www.rabbitongames.com/]website[/url] and follow on Twitter (@[url=https://twitter.com/RabbitonGames]RabbitonGames[/url]) for regular news and projects development!

Again, thank you very much for the support. Hope you can have fun!
